lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地在岩浆里走。
lines.en: I bounce along through the lava.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的岩浆最稠。
lines.en: Basalt delta lava is the thickest.

lines.zh: 我的身体一压就扁，一放就弹。
lines.en: I squash flat and spring right back.
I look like jelly but I'm burning hot.
I hop onto a pillar and slide back down.

lines.zh: 黑灰色的石头，红色的我。
lines.en: Gray black stone, and red me.

lines.zh: 每跳一下，我就滴一点岩浆膏。
lines.en: Each hop drips a little magma cream.

lines.zh: 前面那摊岩浆在冒泡，我要跳进去。
lines.en: That pool is bubbling, I'm jumping in.
Bouncing gets me there faster than swimming.

lines.zh: 灰尘粘在我身上，甩不掉。
lines.en: Ash sticks to me and won't shake off.

lines.zh: 我绕开那些尖锐的黑石。
lines.en: I bounce around the sharp black stone.
My tail works like a spring.

lines.zh: 这里到处都是我的同类。
lines.en: My kind are everywhere around here.
Keep up, I don't bounce very fast.

lines.zh: 岩浆把我托起来，又落下。
lines.en: The lava lifts me and sets me down.

lines.zh: 我跳过窄缝，尾巴甩一下。
lines.en: I hop a narrow gap, tail flicking.

lines.zh: 我停在岩浆上，慢慢往下沉。
lines.en: I rest on the lava and slowly sink.

lines.zh: 身上的岩浆膏又凝了一层。
lines.en: Another layer of magma cream has set.

lines.zh: 我在数自己身上的裂纹。
lines.en: I'm counting the cracks on my body.
The basalt pillars look extra tall today.
Is anyone watching me bounce?
I squash myself and spring up again.
This pool has cooled a little.

lines.zh: 我饿了，想吃点热的东西。
lines.en: I'm hungry for something hot.
Ash got into my eye.
My body quivers very slightly.
My kin are bouncing far off.

lines.zh: 岩浆膏在我背上结成了一块。
lines.en: Magma cream hardened into a lump on my back.
I try to bounce a little higher.

lines.zh: 安静得只剩岩浆的咕噜声。
lines.en: Only the lava's gurgle is left.

lines.zh: 你的靴子看起来能隔热。
lines.en: Your boots look heat proof.

lines.zh: 你比我高好多，我抬头看你。
lines.en: You're so tall, I have to look up.
The ground under you is smoking.
Want to see me bounce?

lines.zh: 你的手别碰我，会粘上岩浆膏。
lines.en: Don't touch me, you'll get magma cream.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的岩浆，我认得每一道。
lines.en: In the basalt delta I know every current of lava.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你的熔岩钓竿。
lines.en: I tilt my head at your lava fishing rod.

lines.zh: 你是不是想把我装进桶里？
lines.en: Are you thinking of putting me in a bucket?

lines.zh: 我在地上留下一圈焦印。
lines.en: I leave a scorched ring where I sit.
You watch, so I'll bounce for you.
Squashed flat, and still bouncing.

lines.zh: 别打我，我只是一块软东西。
lines.en: Don't hit me, I'm just something soft.
My magma cream splattered everywhere.
That flattened me badly.
I jumped straight up from the pain.
A few more cracks appeared.
Isn't your hand burning?
Not again, I'll fall apart.
I curl into a tiny ball.
Steam is rising off my body.
Is that magma cream? Give it here.
What you're holding is glowing hot.
I smell something warm and sweet.
Wave it again and I'll bounce over.
The line moves and I can't help myself.

lines.zh: 我弹到你脚边了，低头看。
lines.en: I bounced to your feet, look down.

lines.zh: 这一小口够我高兴一天。
lines.en: One small bite would make my day.
My drool is bubbling.

lines.zh: 你钩上的肉，在岩浆里发亮。
lines.en: The bait on your hook glows under the lava.
I jump to bite but can't reach.
You stepped on me and I bounced off.
We collided and stuck together.
Don't push, I roll a long way.

lines.zh: 我的岩浆膏蹭到你裤子上了。
lines.en: My magma cream got on your pants.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我压扁又弹起。
lines.en: That squash sent me springing back up.
Your armor feels so cold.
I rolled into a crack and got stuck.
Let me pass, I can't bounce high.

lines.zh: 两只鱼撞一起，声音很闷。
lines.en: Two fish colliding makes a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我身上掉了一块岩浆膏。
lines.en: A chunk of magma cream fell off me.
You bounce once, I'll bounce twice.
We bounce side by side in the same rhythm.
I'll share half my magma cream.

lines.zh: 三角洲西边的岩浆最热。
lines.en: The lava west of the delta is hottest.
Don't squash me, you'll get sticky.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉进这摊岩浆。
lines.en: Let's sink into this pool together.
You bounce higher than me, impressive.

lines.zh: 以后我跟着你的节奏跳。
lines.en: From now on I'll bounce to your rhythm.

lines.zh: 我们的裂纹正好对得上。
lines.en: Our cracks line up perfectly.

lines.zh: 慢点，我粘住你的尾巴了。
lines.en: Slow down, I'm stuck to your tail.
I'll wrap it in magma cream.
This stone is hot to the touch, perfect.
I bounced and it fell out.
I press it down with my body.
It's stuck to my back.
I found it, don't take it.
I opened my mouth and it melted.
This thing is hotter than I am.

lines.zh: 我把它埋进岩浆下的灰里。
lines.en: I bury it in the ash under the lava.
Picking things up is hard for a fish.
Something stepped on the basalt.
My body is tensing up.
It's blocking the way out of the lava.

lines.zh: 我听见了沉重的脚步声。
lines.en: I hear heavy footsteps.
There's a shadow moving over there.
Wrong smell, not one of my kind.
I firm up my body, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 玄武岩缝里，我没什么可躲。
lines.en: In these basalt cracks I have nowhere to hide.
I slide behind a basalt pillar.
If it lowers its head, that's my chance.
I squash flat and store the force.
When it turns away, I spring.
I hop once to test the distance.
The magma cream on me starts to glow.
I bounce around behind its feet.
Hold still, I'm working out the angle.
It lowered its head, I wait.
My tail taps against the ground.

lines.zh: 这一跳要正中它的膝盖。
lines.en: This hop has to land on its knee.
Three, two, one, I'm jumping.
I slam in and lava sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的身体像一块烧红的石头。
lines.en: My body hits like a red hot stone.
The lava carries me into you.
After the hit I bounce far away.

lines.zh: 我的岩浆膏糊在它身上。
lines.en: My magma cream smeared onto it.
That wasn't heavy enough, again.
It pinned me, so I spring hard.
I hear its armor rattle.
My back took the impact and hurts.
Hot blood splashed into the lava.
I popped up out of the lava.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的灰落了我一身。
lines.en: Basalt ash settled all over me.
I came out soft and squishy.

lines.zh: 四周黑石林立，热得发烫。
lines.en: Black stone towers around, blistering hot.
I tried one bounce right away.
Lots of my kin are bouncing here.
My first mouthful was lava.

lines.zh: 我看见远处的岩浆湖在冒烟。
lines.en: I see a lava lake steaming far off.
My tail is still trembling.
First, I'll lean against a pillar.
Compared to lava, fire is mild.
I fell and bounced even higher.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，全变成白烟。
lines.en: Water hit me and turned to white steam.
The blast threw me into a pillar.
An arrow wedged into my cracks.
My magma cream is going cold.

lines.zh: 岩浆里没吃的，我瘦得更方了。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the lava; I grow even squarer.
Lightning struck sparks right off me.
I'm falling into pure blackness.
